estilo: Photorealistic cinematic travel film frame in the style of a high-end adventure travel filmmaker: full-frame cinema camera, natural tropical sunlight with lens flares, vivid but natural color grade (teal water, warm skin), real skin texture with pores, fine flyaway hair, candid genuine emotion, dynamic composition, shallow depth of field. Real anatomy (five fingers, natural feet). Tasteful and family-friendly, not sexualized. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
refs: Same exact people as the reference images (Marisol: Latina woman 27, long dark wavy hair, light freckles; Diego: Latino man 29, short dark curly hair, short beard). Preserve faces, ages, hair, body proportions. Wardrobe A = Marisol coral linen crop top + ivory linen shorts, Diego open navy linen shirt + cream tee + sand shorts. Wardrobe B = Marisol terracotta modest one-piece swimsuit (scoop neck) with open ivory linen shirt or without it in water, Diego navy swim shorts with open white linen shirt or without it in water.
